title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 28 FEBRUARY 2026 Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 27 February 2026 Except for showers or thundershowers that may occur at a few places in Kaluthara, Rathnapura, Galle and Matara districts after 2.00 pm, mainly fair weather will prevail over the other areas of the island. Misty conditions can be expected at several places in the island during the early hours of the morning.
